lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Joice Lopes Leite | Lesson 20 -- Moving Forward, Looking Back

listenings.text: Dear group, thank you for the first part of the year. Here is what we are going to do next. We are going to continue the work with public schools, and we are going to prepare a new report together. The first version is going to be ready in October. We are not going to work with the big schools this semester: we decided to give all our time to the small ones. In November we are going to Belém, and five people from this group are presenting there. Thank you, and see you soon.

Hi, Joice. This is a message only for you. Twenty lessons ago you recorded one minute about your work, and you could not finish it. Today you record two minutes and you do not stop. Nothing changed in your intelligence, and nothing changed in your accent. What changed is that you tried, twice a week, for twenty lessons. In November you are going to speak in Belém. You are going to be nervous, and you are going to do it anyway. That is the whole method.

extra_audio.text: Joice listens to her first recording from lesson one. She listens to her recording from lesson nineteen. She writes three things that are different. She decides what she is going to do in the next block. She sends her plan to the teacher.

reading.rtitle: Meteoro Program -- Letter to the Group, Second Semester
paras: Dear all, thank you for the first part of the year. This letter is about what we are going to do next, and about one change in the plan.
We are going to continue the work with public schools, and we are going to prepare a new report together, with the teachers inside it. The first version is going to be ready in October.
We are not going to work with the big schools this semester. That is the change: we decided to give all our time to the small ones.
In November we are going to Belém. Five people from this group are presenting there, and Joice is one of them. This is the first time for her, and we are going to prepare it together.
